httpstatus.t01: Headers received — keep sending the body
httpstatus.t04: A resource was created (a successful POST)
httpstatus.t05: Accepted, but not processed yet (async work)
httpstatus.t06: Succeeded with nothing to return (DELETE and friends)
httpstatus.t07: Only part of a ranged request (resumed downloads, video)
httpstatus.t08: The address moved for good — search engines follow it
httpstatus.t10: After a POST, go see the result with a GET
httpstatus.t12: Temporary move — do not change the method
httpstatus.t13: Permanent move — do not change the method
httpstatus.t14: The request itself is wrong (shape, parameters)
httpstatus.t15: Authentication needed — really "I do not know who you are"
httpstatus.t16: Payment required (quota exceeded on some APIs)
httpstatus.t17: I know who you are, but you are not allowed
httpstatus.t20: The client was too slow sending
httpstatus.t21: Conflicts with the current state (concurrent edits)
httpstatus.t22: It existed once and is gone for good
httpstatus.t23: The body you sent is too large
httpstatus.t25: An April Fools code — genuinely in a standards document
httpstatus.t27: Too many requests — retry in a moment
httpstatus.t28: The server broke (the catch-all for unknown causes)
httpstatus.t29: The server has not implemented that
httpstatus.t30: The front server got a strange answer from the back
httpstatus.t31: Overloaded or under maintenance — not accepting now
httpstatus.t32: The back server did not answer in time
httpstatus.t43: Search by number or name (e.g. 404, timeout, redirect)
